data.body:
Gap analysis AC amendments:
(1) Ticket detection mechanism: workflow MUST fetch the tickets orphan branch before checking for tracking ticket existence (tickets branch is not in default GHA checkout). Add step: git fetch origin tickets. Structural test must assert fetch step precedes existence check.
(2) UTC timezone: constant must live in one shared source (dso-config.conf or exported shell snippet) sourced by BOTH calibration-report.sh and the workflow file — not independently hardcoded. Test must assert workflow references shared source, not literal TZ value.
(3) Failure handling: specify behavior when mutation-append succeeds but churn-append fails (partial-append failure). Add if: failure() or equivalent surfacing step so partial failures are visible. The two append steps must not leave rollup state inconsistent without a recovery path.
